title: 第7章 想给少爷生猴子第8章 我是灌篮高手
slug: 给你玉女心经没让你用双修证道
content_zh:
月儿看到正呆呆看棚顶的黄夜，内心稍稍平复一些。
他这个样子倒还正常，只要耐心点，早晚有机会。
“少爷，吃午饭了。”
黄夜依旧瞪着棚顶。
月儿推了推晴儿，晴儿睁开迷蒙的双眼。
“姐姐，吃饭了！”
“嗯！”
月儿把食盒端到床前。
晴儿勉强侧过身子，准备吃饭，黄夜依旧没反应。
“姐姐，少爷的样子好像不想吃。”
“没事儿，他应该不饿，上午吃了不少糕点。”
晴儿草草吃完，月儿端着食盒退出去。
“少爷，您为什么不吃？”
“我信不过她。”
“哦！少爷怀疑她。”
“嘿嘿，这个丫头不简单。”
黄夜还不想把月儿刺杀的事情说出来。
虽然晴儿可靠，但在这种环境下，只是可靠没什么用，还要会演戏。
如果晴儿对月儿产生敌意，月儿很可能发现异常。
他暂时不想对月儿动手，至少要查出月儿后面的黑手是谁。

把一个刺客养在身边，也能时刻提高警觉性。
此时的晴儿也有点迷惑，刚才实在太痛，少爷清醒后的异常表现，她并未深想。
现在仔细回想一下，少爷有点不像刚刚清醒的样子。
他昏迷的时候才十岁，还是个孩子。
可他刚才的表现很诡异，有点像吴管家那种老奸巨猾的样子。
还有就是他询问的事情，很多名词从未听说。
自己很小就进府，虽然赶不上富家小姐那样知书达理，但也读书识字。
书更是看了不少，自己从未听说的东西，少爷怎么知道的？
算了，不想了，少爷醒了就是好事儿。
唉！不知少爷何时能要了我，很想给少爷生猴子。
“晴儿，你可有不适的感觉？”
黄夜打断晴儿的思绪。
“少爷指的是哪方面？”
content_en:
Yue'er felt a little calmer when she saw Huang Ye staring blankly at the roof of the shed.
It's normal for him to look like this. As long as he is patient, he will have a chance sooner or later.
"Master, it's time for lunch."
Huang Ye still stared at the roof of the shed.
Yue'er pushed Qing'er, and Qing'er opened her misty eyes.
"Sister, it's time to eat!"
"Yeah!"
Yue'er brought the food box to the bed.
Qing'er reluctantly turned sideways and prepared to eat, but Huang Ye still didn't respond.
"Sister, the young master doesn't seem to want to eat."
"It's okay. He shouldn't be hungry. He ate a lot of cakes in the morning."
Qing'er finished eating hastily, and Yue'er took the food box and exited.
"Master, why don't you eat?"
"I can't trust her."
"Oh! The young master doubts her."
"Hehe, this girl is not simple."
Huang Ye didn't want to tell Yue'er about the assassination yet.
Although Qing'er is reliable, in this environment, being reliable is of no use, and she also needs to be able to act.
If Qing'er becomes hostile to Yue'er, Yue'er is likely to notice something abnormal.
He didn't want to take action against Yue'er for the time being, at least he wanted to find out who was behind Yue'er.
Keeping an assassin by your side can also increase your alertness at all times.
At this time, Qing'er was also a little confused. It was too painful just now. She didn't think deeply about the abnormal behavior of the young master after he woke up.
Now that I think about it carefully, the young master doesn't look like he just woke up.
He was ten years old and a child when he fell into a coma.
But his behavior just now was very strange, a bit like Butler Wu's cunning look.
There are also many terms he has never heard of about the things he asked about.
I entered the government at a very young age. Although I am not as well-educated as a rich lady, I am still able to read and write.
I have read a lot of books. How does the young master know something that I have never heard of?
Forget it, don't think about it anymore, it's a good thing that the young master is awake.
well! I don’t know when the young master will have me. I really want to give birth to a monkey for the young master.
"Qing'er, do you feel uncomfortable?"
Huang Ye interrupted Qing'er's thoughts.
"What are you referring to, Master?"
